title: Dependency Phase Matrix and Escalation Schematic for Roadmap Cutovers
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a prescriptive, machine-readable Phase Matrix and an accompanying Escalation Schematic to reduce surprise blockers during roadmap cutovers. This ticket scopes a cross-team operational artifact that defines: phase bands (Commit/Alert/Block), alignment gates per functional area (Engineering, Design, Security, Infra), automated staleness detection rules, and an on-call escalation rota for dependency remediation. Outputs: (1) Confluence Phase Matrix template and decision guide, (2) CSV/JSON schema for dependency ingestion into the Console signals pipeline, (3) a lightweight dashboard prototype showing per-initiative phase and entropy score, (4) runbook snippets for PM/Eng leads and Security reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Phase Matrix template published in Confluence with explicit gates for Eng/Design/Security/Infra and example completed for two near-term initiatives. 2) JSON schema accepted by Eng infra team and a working PoC that can export/import dependency state. 3) Dashboard prototype wired to test data showing phase transitions and staleness alerts. 4) Escalation schematic (roles & SLA windows) reviewed and signed off by Eng lead and Security. 5) Two simulated cutovers executed in tabletop run with documented lessons learned.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Aisha: Kickoff with Eng/Design/Security/Infra. Agreed problem statement: teams lack a shared notion of readiness and a single source to trigger escalations during cutover.
2026-03-03 - Eng lead (Maya Chen): Proposed 3 commitment bands instead of 4 to minimize cognitive overhead. Suggested mapping to existing rollout states in Console. Action: Eng to draft JSON schema.

2026-03-04 - Security (Omar Ruiz): Flagged that Security gate must include both code review and compliance checklist; recommended 'security-block' tag. Also asked for note on any data-migration dependencies. Action: add security checklist to template.

2026-03-05 - Design (Priya Kapoor): Concern about timing of design signoff in the Phase Matrix — proposed explicit 'UX freeze' window and a soft-acceptance state for visual polish. We captured examples in the Confluence doc.

2026-03-06 - Liam: PoC JSON schema v0.1 uploaded to drive and referenced in links. Engineering will wire a small import into the Console staging dashboard next week. Trade-off: schema includes minimal fields to start (owner, expected-cutover, band, blockers, last-updated) to reduce integration work.

2026-03-07 - Aisha: Scoped tabletop run for 2026-03-22; invite list includes PMs, Eng leads, Design leads, Security reviewer, and Infra oncall. Next: finalize escalation rota and staleness thresholds.
